# uptimeeye_report_schedule (Resource)

The uptime report schedule of a status page. Each status page has at most one schedule (singleton, upserted via PUT). The API has no delete operation: destroying this resource disables the report schedule (`enabled = false`) rather than deleting it. Import with the status page id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimeeye_report_schedule" "weekly" {
  status_page_id = uptimeeye_status_page.public.id
  cadence        = "weekly"
  recipients     = ["reports@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cadence` (String) How often reports are sent. One of `weekly`, `monthly`.
- `recipients` (List of String) Email addresses the report is sent to. At least one recipient is required.
- `status_page_id` (String) Id of the status page the reports are generated for. Changing this forces a new schedule.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether reports are actually sent.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Schedule identifier; equal to `status_page_id` (one schedule per page).
